$comment: Specs skipped only by `bun run test:e2e:ledger`. Each entry is explained in docs/engine/e2e-ledger.md. Remove an entry in the same change that makes its test pass.

tests: editable Pen, canvas text, graph and preview controls render coherently
entries.reason: Timeout waiting for the "Text animator presets" group and its Rise button; that group no longer exists in src (removed in a5e3fbb6, 2026-10-05). Stale spec; the text animator UI it drives was redesigned.

tests: precompose preserves cross-boundary animated rig pixels at several frames
entries.reason: PM.precompose of a parented, rotating rig changes rendered pixels: the mean absolute difference at t = 0.4, 1, 1.8 is not below 1 CV for every sample (expected all true, got false). Evaluation parity across a precomposition boundary.

tests: agent image attachments open a fitted preview and Escape returns focus
entries.reason: Escape closes the preview but focus does not return to the "View reference.png" trigger. Pointer-clicked buttons are blurred since 352f1d1e (2026-10-09, "Fix pointer-clicked buttons retaining keyboard focus"), so the trigger the spec clicks has no focus to restore. Product and spec disagree; decide which behavior is intended.

tests: the agent watches and listens to imported footage through the media tools
entries.reason: The final model request carries 8 data:image attachments; the spec expects 4 (2 frames + 1 sheet + 1 composition sheet). Suspected extra visual-context frames from e7e3ccb1 ("Improve agent visual context"). Agent snapshots move to the engine, so the count matters for the port.

tests: a real mod supplies import defaults and Properties controls with automatic cleanup
entries.reason: Stale spec: reads the raw window.powermove bridge (powermove.extensions.setEnabled), which the renderer seals at boot since bfcd2c88 (2026-09-23, sandbox X1b); window.powermove is undefined in the page.

entries.reason: Escape does not close the Export dialog, so Export Captions opens on top of it and locator('.export-modal') matches two dialogs (strict mode).
